title: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). translated_title: 时间序列基础模型的循环域增量自适应
translated_abstract: 预训练的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）为下游分类任务提供了强大的表示能力。然而，在不断变化的运行条件下对TSFM进行自适应仍然具有挑战性。模型必须在每个新观测到的运行条件上取得改进，同时不损害其已经学习过的条件，而且往往只有一个很小的带标签校准集可用，并且在推理时无法得知当前的运行条件。我们发现这一困难背后存在重要的几何结构。在运行条件发生偏移时，TSFM的嵌入空间并不是均匀移动的：某些局部区域变化显著，而其他区域几乎保持不变。因此，全局式的自适应可能会不必要地移动那些本已被正确分类的嵌入。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了新颖的PACT（通过图卡传输的分段自适应）方法。PACT将冻结的源嵌入空间划分为局部图卡，并学习轻量级的残差变换……
tldr: 该论文提出PACT方法，将冻结的嵌入空间划分为局部图卡并进行轻量级的分段残差自适应，从而在运行条件不断变化的情况下实现时间序列基础模型的域增量自适应，同时避免全局自适应破坏已正确分类的嵌入表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACT, which partitions the frozen embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight piecewise residual adaptations, enabling domain-incremental adaptation of time-series foundation models under shifting operating conditions while avoiding unnecessary disruption of already correctly classified embeddings.
